speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing double vision, difficulty climbing stairs, and upper limb weakness; to better understand your condition, can you tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if they worsen with activity?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those symptoms are concerning for a neuromuscular disorder, specifically Myasthenia Gravis. To confirm this and rule out other causes, please complete a Tensilon (edrophonium) test and a Chest X-Ray to check for thymoma. REQUEST TEST: Tensilon_test, REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray.
